title: Wildfire: Mar 2025 Southern Plains

truth_source.note: URMA is an analysis: a blend of surface observations with a short-range model background. Where observations are sparse it leans on the model and inherits its smoothness and biases. Comparing with it measures agreement with a best estimate, not with reality, and it is least certain where forecasts are hardest.

grid.note: 0.1° latitude-longitude box, 26–40.5° N and 94–107° W; every model and the analysis interpolated to it (bilinear) by MET Grid-Stat

quantization: 8-bit, one fixed scale per variable; readouts are approximate to one scale step
